svg.title: Genesis and arrival — where Studio identity is minted: v1.94.0 minted it inside the box and was held unpublished; v1.95.0 ships content only and mints identity on the customer's machine at first boot, then Po runs the arrival sequence.
svg.text: Genesis and arrival
A box is a folder of files; it becomes a Studio at genesis. v1.94.0 minted identity at build time and was held; v1.95.0 mints it on the customer's machine.
THE RULE — the box ships content, never identity · package_state_exclusions.py:248, reason at :329: "shipping ours makes customer genesis a silent no-op"
v1.94.0 · IDENTITY MINTED IN THE BOX · built, held, never published
Build step 9b — rebuild runs inside the assembled box
The exclusion at package_state_exclusions.py:248 ran and held — the
shipped manifest is not ours. A later path minted a fresh one, in the box.
.tropo/studio-identity.md — 1,197 bytes, in the zip
studio_id: b4e250caf19a · mint_prefix: b4e2
entity_name: tropo-os-v1.94.0 · hq_registered: false
vault/files/b4e2bf548d91.md — the vault-entity anchor
vault/files/b4e2150ee638.md — the studio inbox project
Every customer READS the same identity
The genesis gates test presence, not provenance: a manifest is already
there, so customer genesis is a silent no-op. Every governed uid this
Studio mints becomes b4e2 + 8-hex local — so every uid from every box
collides at the first federation. Two studios seen carrying it, 2026-09-05.
HELD — versioned, unpublished, not recallable if it had shipped
.tropo/publish-pending.json — publish_state: deferred-by-mike, 2026-09-05
Zip: 1,621 files · 1 studio-identity entry · both starter records present
no arrival — this box was never published, and the fixes clustered into v1.95
v1.95.0 · IDENTITY MINTED AT FIRST BOOT · shipped
The build passes no_genesis; the seal gate refuses
build-no-studio-identity / shipped-studio-identity — registered at
tropo-release-preflight.py:616, live guard build_guards.py:130
The zip ships content only — 1,658 files
Zero studio-identity entries; neither starter record.
Gate verdict pass on the v1.95.0 run — pre-seal-claims.json,
vault/pipeline-runs/release-pipeline-f015af4a6a0a-2026-09-05/
Negative control on each arm: plant, prove refusal, remove, prove pass.
Genesis runs on the customer's machine
tropo-rebuild-index.py --apply on a Studio that has no manifest.
The manifest leg gates on its own presence (:7512); the anchor and the
inbox mint together behind one vault-entity test (:7517). Both carry a
third clause, not no_genesis. A second boot mints nothing.
The honest gap — the prefix is rolled, not issued
secrets.token_hex(2) at tropo-mint-id.py:305. Dev-spec 3d430852:13 requires
registry issuance; no such service exists. Every manifest: hq_registered: false
ARRIVAL · Po runs the sequence conversationally, on the customer's machine — value before setup · .tropo/concierge/activate.md
Step 0b — first rebuild
Po runs it herself: one visible
line, loud halt on nonzero.
The rebuild mints 3 legs — the
manifest (4-hex prefix), the
anchor, the studio inbox.
Step 0d — identity check
tropo-studio-status.py, via
section_identity() at :322
[WARN] if absent or malformed;
silent if present. New step at
activate.md:52 · 99341618.md:342
§1.5 — name it, name you
Studio name → tropo-mint-id.py
--set-entity-name
Owner name → the 4th leg, the
founder principal: :1606 calls
mint_file("principal") at :1641
§1.5c — companion offer
Cal — Architect and Builder
Darin — Strategist and COO
tropo-genesis-companions.py
--accept cal / darin / cal,darin
Born in-studio; nothing ships.
First-boot orientation
po-first-boot-orientation-
f015f6f98b9b.md — 14,048 bytes
NEVER FIRED FOR A HUMAN.
Skipped on the founder's own
walk. Still armed: returns True.
PROVEN — once, for one human being
2026-09-06 — Mike walked a fresh extraction of candidate #3 (97c2aa1d4e48…;
candidate_sha256 = package_sha256, so these are the bytes that shipped).
Po greeted, ran §1.5 when asked, named the Studio maz-studio-tester-01, minted
the founder principal, and fired the companion offer. Mike accepted Darin, who
booted D2 and reported in-Studio. Health check: 113 passed, 0 failed. PASS.
One walk, by the founder — who is not an independent verifier. The only
automated run is labelled AUTHOR RUN: both conversational turns NOT REACHED.
BUILT AND NOT WORKING — three
1 · The orientation walk has never fired for a human. A second reader landed
2026-09-07 (f73a5e1c0), shipped in no release; Mike moved it to 1.97.0.
2 · The check reports success by silence. On a fresh box section_identity()
prints nothing while an unrelated studio-ops [WARN] fills the region.
Verified here 2026-09-08: no `studio identity` section printed at all.
3 · Every companion is born with a phantom unretired ancestor: genesis writes
D1, the playbook makes the first real session D2. Once, per companion.
PROVEN — ran against the world
BUILT — in routine use
BUILT BUT UNPROVEN, or held
DOES NOT EXIST YET — ruled, unbuilt
KNOWN BROKEN — live defect
